definitions.full: H5388. neshiyyah נְשִׁיָּה noun feminine forgetfulness, oblivion , נ ׳אֶרֶץ Psa 88:13 (|| חשֶׁךְ ), designation of שְׁאוֺל (compare 88:11 ; 88:12 ).
